notes: Near-miss quote. Golden quotes must be verbatim substrings of input.txt (the runner matches by containment), so the near miss is expressed with the tester extension 'fuzzy_quote': a typo-corrected copy a model is likely to return. tests/unit/eval-fixtures.test.ts replays each fuzzy_quote and checks that it is not verbatim, verifies only by fuzzy match (measured 0.95, 0.97, 0.95 against the 0.9 threshold), is stored as the source span (so it still matches the golden), and keeps the golden band and due date. Bands are chosen so exact and fuzzy land in the same band (fuzzy loses only the +0.05 exact-quote bonus): 0.90 -> 0.85 stays High, 0.35 -> 0.30 stays Low. evals/run.ts ignores fuzzy_quote. A quote that drifts further (paraphrase) is dropped as quote_unverified and is a recall miss; watch the live run's unverified-quote count here.
